title: Semantic Kernel Planners & AI Connectors
description: Master automated multi-step planning with Stepwise and Handlebars planners and configure multi-provider AI connectors in .NET.

data.text: In complex enterprise applications, a user's goal might require orchestrating multiple tools across different plugins—for example: 'Find the top 3 customers with outstanding invoices over $5,000, calculate their late penalties, and generate draft reminder emails.' Manually coding every permutation of tool calls is impossible. Semantic Kernel Planners solve this by taking a user goal and a registry of available plugins, and using the LLM to dynamically generate and execute an orchestration plan.

rows: Iterative ReAct loop leveraging native OpenAI/Azure function calling
Highly reliable, self-correcting on tool errors, handles dynamic branching
Enterprise default for multi-step data lookups and tool actions
Generates an entire Handlebars template representing the full execution plan upfront
Fast (single planning call), supports loops and conditionals natively
Less adaptive if an early step returns unexpected data
Structured multi-stage workflows with known intermediate shapes

data.text: The Function Calling Stepwise Planner uses modern model tool-calling capabilities to plan, execute, observe, and adjust execution steps.

data.text: Semantic Kernel abstracts provider endpoints via Connectors. You can configure multiple connectors simultaneously—for example, Azure OpenAI for production chat, a local Ollama connector for offline development, and Mistral or Anthropic as secondary failover providers.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Planners dynamically orchestrate multi-plugin steps from high-level natural language goals
FunctionCallingStepwisePlanner is the enterprise recommendation for reliable, self-correcting plans
Always set MaxIterations and ExecutionTimeLimit to safeguard against infinite planning loops
Inspect the planner's intermediate execution transcript for auditing and debugging
AI connectors abstract model providers, allowing seamless switching between Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, and local models
data.takeaway: Semantic Kernel Planners bring true autonomy to .NET applications. By combining multiple plugins with a Stepwise Planner, you transform isolated C# methods into an adaptive, self-orchestrating system.
